findings.issue_text: Prometheus-only rule list rows pass no `rule`, but `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` requires one, so the enabled “Silence notifications” action only toggles state and never opens the drawer
`GrafanaRuleListItem` is missing its `key={key}` prop, allowing React to reuse row-local state for the wrong rule when filtered results are reordered or removed

goldens.comment: The rendered GrafanaRuleListItem is missing the required key prop for React list items. This can cause rendering issues when the list order changes.

RuleActionsButtons is invoked with only promRule, but SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer inside RuleActionsButtons still depends on a Grafana Ruler rule being present, so for Grafana rules coming from list views the 'Silence notifications' menu entry (now driven by Grafana Prom abilities) will toggle showSilenceDrawer without ever rendering the drawer. This means clicking 'Silence notifications' for these rules has no visible effect, even when abilities indicate silencing is allowed.

per_golden_matches.golden_comment: The rendered GrafanaRuleListItem is missing the required key prop for React list items. This can cause rendering issues when the list order changes.
per_golden_matches.matched_candidate: `GrafanaRuleListItem` is missing its `key={key}` prop, allowing React to reuse row-local state for the wrong rule when filtered results are reordered or removed
per_golden_matches.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies the exact same problem as the golden comment - that the GrafanaRuleListItem component is missing the required 'key' prop for React list items. Both comments point out that this missing key prop can cause rendering/state issues when the list order changes (reordering, filtering, removal). The candidate provides slightly more detail about the consequences (row-local state reuse) but it's fundamentally the same issue.

per_golden_matches.matched_candidate: Prometheus-only rule list rows pass no `rule`, but `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` requires one, so the enabled “Silence notifications” action only toggles state and never opens the drawer
per_golden_matches.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies the exact same problem as the golden comment: when only a Prometheus rule is passed (no Grafana Ruler rule), the SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer requires a rule to render, so clicking 'Silence notifications' only toggles the showSilenceDrawer state without actually rendering/opening the drawer. Both comments point to the same bug where the silence action appears enabled but has no visible effect.
